content.content:
We need to produce a travel plan for 7 days, March 18-24 2022, starting in Washington (likely Washington state? Or Washington DC? ambiguous). Visiting 3 cities in Minnesota. Budget $7200. Need to output plan via submit_day_plan calls for each day. No follow-up. We need to decide itinerary: start Washington, travel to Minnesota (maybe multiple cities). 7 days includes travel days.

Assume Washington state (e.g., Seattle). Could fly to Minneapolis, then go to other MN cities like Duluth and Rochester. Return to Washington? Not specified; maybe end in Minnesota? Trip ends March 24, maybe return to Washington? Not required. We'll create plan: Day1: travel from Seattle to Minneapolis. Day2: Minneapolis attractions. Day3: travel to Duluth, explore. Day4: Duluth attractions. Day5: travel to Rochester, explore. Day6: Rochester attractions. Day7: return to Seattle.

We need fill fields: transportation, breakfast, attraction, lunch, dinner, accommodation. Provide realistic suggestions.

We must call submit_day_plan for each day. Use '-' if not applicable.

Let's craft.

Day1: transportation: Flight Number: DL1234, from Seattle to Minneapolis, Departure Time: 08:00, Arrival Time: 12:30.

Breakfast: maybe at hotel in Seattle before departure: "The Original Pancake House, Seattle". Attraction: none? Use "-"? Field must have something; we can put "-" for attraction. Lunch: "Mendocino Farms, Minneapolis". Dinner: "The Old Spaghetti Factory, Minneapolis". Accommodation: "Hyatt Regency Minneapolis".

Day2: city Minneapolis. Transportation: "-". Breakfast: "Hell's Kitchen, Minneapolis". Attraction: "Minneapolis Institute of Art, Minneapolis; Walker Art Center, Minneapolis; Mall of America, Bloomington". Lunch: "Al's Breakfast, Minneapolis". Dinner: "Spoon and Stable, Minneapolis". Accommodation: same.

Day3: travel to Duluth. Transportation: "Flight Number: DL5678, from Minneapolis to Duluth, Departure Time: 09:00, Arrival Time: 10:00". Breakfast: "Hen House Eatery, Minneapolis". Attraction: "-" (travel). Lunch: "Grandma's Saloon & Grill, Duluth". Dinner: "Va Bene, Duluth". Accommodation: "Fitger's Inn, Duluth".

Day4: Duluth city. Transportation: "-". Breakfast: "Northern Waters Café, Duluth". Attraction: "Canal Park, Duluth; Great Lakes Aquarium, Duluth; Aerial Lift Bridge, Duluth". Lunch: "Lake Avenue Restaurant & Bar, Duluth". Dinner: "Bent Paddle Brewing Company, Duluth". Accommodation: same.

Day5: travel to Rochester. Transportation: "Flight Number: DL9012, from Duluth to Rochester, Departure Time: 08:30, Arrival Time: 09:30". Breakfast: "Kettle River Café, Duluth". Attraction: "-". Lunch: "The Good Food Café, Rochester". Dinner: "Pescara, Rochester". Accommodation: "Kaleidoscope Hotel & Spa, Rochester".

Day6: Rochester city. Transportation: "-". Breakfast: "Spoonful of Love, Rochester". Attraction: "Mayo Clinic Museum, Rochester; Quarry Hill Nature Center, Rochester; Historic Plummer House, Rochester". Lunch: "The Original Pancake House, Rochester". Dinner: "Café Coby, Rochester". Accommodation: same.

Day7: return to Seattle. Transportation: "Flight Number: DL3456, from Rochester to Seattle, Departure Time: 10:00, Arrival Time: 13:30". Breakfast: "The Buttered Biscuit, Rochester". Attraction: "-". Lunch: "In-flight meal". Dinner: "Home". Accommodation: "Home".

We must call submit_day_plan for each day. Ensure fields strings.

json_schema.description:
Once you have collected information about the trip, call this function once for each day of the trip, starting on day 1.
If a field does not apply for a given day, use "-" to indicate this.
You MUST call this function to save the plan for each query.

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

transportation.description: e.g. "Flight Number: F3633413, from Ithaca to Charlotte, Departure Time: 05:38, Arrival Time: 07:46"

breakfast.description: The name of a restaurant in the city, e.g. "Nagaland's Kitchen, Charlotte"

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"

json_schema.title: submit_day_plan
